subject.title: feat(memory): default cross-conversation recall for personal installs

question: Should OpenClaw change unset `memorySearch.rememberAcrossConversations` from explicit opt-in to automatic enablement for configurations inferred to be personal installs, and publish the resolver through the Plugin SDK?
rationale: This is a durable privacy, upgrade, and Plugin SDK contract decision; automated review can verify the implementation but cannot choose the product default or permanent extension boundary.

options.title: Keep explicit opt-in
options.body: Preserve the merged feature’s default-off behavior and avoid publishing the new resolver until a narrower approved SDK seam is needed.

options.title: Approve conditional default-on
options.body: Accept the inferred-personal-install default and the SDK resolver after reviewing upgrade behavior and the permanent plugin API contract.

recommendation.title: Approve conditional default-on
recommendation.body: Accept the inferred-personal-install default and the SDK resolver after reviewing upgrade behavior and the permanent plugin API contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the merged feature and its existing explicit opt-in contract.
